scope: Fourteenth bounded target-specific wave: 12 current completion-unproved Finance and Privacy targets; four independently accepted direct source slices and eight conservative retained-unproved decisions.

methodology.runtime_boundary: No application, browser, database, deployment or product Git state was changed.
methodology.no_copy_rule: Evidence is behavioural only; do not copy source, schema, UI, wording or distinctive layouts.

source_slice_reuse_disclosure: FIN-BANK-TRANSACTION is limited to ERPNext bank-transaction validation/status lines 13-116. ERPNext allocation/reconciliation lines 174-304 and the previously credited BigCapital MatchTransactions slice are explicitly excluded to avoid collision with FIN-BANK-RECONCILIATION and FIN-PAYMENT-MATCH.

The two Fides credits use disjoint source loci: the DSR package builder for export generation and the privacy-request endpoints for fulfilment decisions. No other target receives inherited Fides credit.

ERPNEXT.edition_boundary: Pinned official community repository source only; hosted services, paid/Enterprise/private extensions and unpinned refs are excluded.

PIA.edition_boundary: Pinned official community repository source only; hosted services, paid/private extensions and unpinned refs are excluded.

FIDES.edition_boundary: Pinned src/ community repository source only; hosted services, paid/private extensions and unpinned refs are excluded.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Persist and validate a bank transaction record with bounded transaction status and duplicate-reference controls.

benchmark.edition_boundary: Pinned official community repository source only; hosted services, paid/Enterprise/private extensions and unpinned refs are excluded.
benchmark.proven_slice: ERPNext materially persists and validates Bank Transaction currency, status and duplicate references.
benchmark.parity_limits: Only transaction validation/status is credited. Lines 174-304, allocation, reconciliation, matching, Site authority, UX and runtime parity are excluded.
benchmark.p6_caveats: Benchmark-only behavior; do not copy source, schema, labels, layouts or product wording.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Create, persist and update a DPIA draft with structured assessment material.

benchmark.proven_slice: PIA creates a draft with timestamps, status, progress and structure-bound assessment material, then persists updates.
benchmark.parity_limits: Independent review/approval, Site authority, runtime and UX parity are excluded; CAP-PRIV-DPIA-REVIEW-APPROVAL remains unproved.
benchmark.p6_caveats: Benchmark-only behavior; do not copy source, schema, labels, layouts or product wording.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Build a navigable, attachment-aware DSR export package.

benchmark.edition_boundary: Pinned src/ community repository source only; hosted services, paid/private extensions and unpinned refs are excluded.
benchmark.proven_slice: Fides builds a navigable DSR ZIP with dataset pages and optional attachments and closes the package correctly.
benchmark.parity_limits: Request review, fulfilment decisions, authorization, retention, Site authority, runtime and UX parity are excluded.
benchmark.p6_caveats: Benchmark-only behavior; do not copy source, schema, labels, layouts or product wording.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Record scoped approve or deny fulfilment decisions and actor-attributed finalization.

benchmark.edition_boundary: Pinned src/ community repository source only; hosted services, paid/private extensions and unpinned refs are excluded.
benchmark.proven_slice: Fides requires request-review scope, records the reviewer for approve/deny, rejects invalid state and records finalizer/time before completion.
benchmark.parity_limits: Export-package generation, Site authority, identity verification, deadlines, runtime and UX parity are excluded.
benchmark.p6_caveats: Benchmark-only behavior; do not copy source, schema, labels, layouts or product wording.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Govern an external bank-feed provider connection and synchronization lifecycle with recovery state.
evaluations.bounded_reason: Import/feed handling does not prove a governed external-provider connection, synchronization state or recovery lifecycle.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Persist and govern consolidation-group membership and configuration.
evaluations.bounded_reason: No inspected candidate proved a persistent consolidation-group configuration lifecycle.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Execute governed, replay-safe consolidation runs with durable run state.
evaluations.bounded_reason: On-demand reporting is not a governed, replay-safe consolidation-run lifecycle.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Import, reconcile and govern EFTPOS batches.
evaluations.bounded_reason: Generic POS closeout does not establish EFTPOS batch import and reconciliation.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Register and govern EFTPOS terminal identity, custody and lifecycle.
evaluations.bounded_reason: Generic POS configuration does not establish EFTPOS terminal registration, custody or lifecycle.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Require independent DPIA review and an actor-attributed approval decision.
evaluations.bounded_reason: Status labels do not establish an independent reviewer, authorization boundary or decision audit.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Govern DSR identity verification and deadline/extension provenance.
evaluations.bounded_reason: Identity fields and due dates do not prove governed verification plus extension lifecycle and provenance.

evaluations.neutral_requirement: Execute retention-policy-driven deletion with durable deletion-log evidence.
evaluations.bounded_reason: DSR erasure is not retention-policy-driven deletion with durable deletion-log evidence.
